utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep it loose and check with Dane or Rosa before I tell anyone anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — once you hear back, just send me what’s confirmed versus still uncertain, and I’ll update the supply list carefully.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll ping Dane and Rosa when I get a minute, then send you only the confirmed bits and flag anything still fuzzy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive this Saturday morning—could you lend a hand with setup or bring any small repair tools if you’ve got them?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m catching up a bit late, but yes—I can help with setup Saturday morning and bring a basic tool kit for small appliance or bike fixes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane—that’s perfect; I’ll count you in for setup and have your toolkit available for the small appliance or bike lane as needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Pia, I’m pulling the repair drive details together—Rosa says Sunday at the community center, and Gus has tools covered, but can you confirm the drop-off spot before Tess starts outreach?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d hold Tess for now, Mara—I only have Saturday morning collection and sorting confirmed, not Sunday or Gus covering tools. Let me verify the community center drop-off before anyone announces it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Pia—I’ll hold Tess and won’t mention Sunday, Gus, or the community center drop-off until you verify them. For now I’ll treat Saturday morning collection and sorting as the only confirmed piece.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Opal, I’m still waiting on Cleo for the confirmed repair drive time and drop-off spot before I spread it around—have you heard anything solid from her?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet, Tess—I don’t have anything confirmed from Cleo, so I’m leaving the time and drop-off spot blank on the map until she gives us something solid.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call, Opal—keep that map blank for now, and I’ll hold off on telling folks until Cleo confirms the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Gus—I'm keeping this low-key, but from what I know Quinn is the safest person to check with for confirmed repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli—I’ll check in with Quinn before I haul everything over, just to make sure the drills, clamps, workbench, and hand tools are actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds wise, Gus—Quinn will know what won’t just get in the way. I appreciate you checking first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mina, before I tell anyone anything, can you confirm your sign-up sheet is the latest one and the actual date for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, Kira—don’t announce it until Ira reports back tonight and I cross-check with Vik. I’ll confirm the date and the latest sign-up sheet after that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I won’t pass anything along yet—please send me the confirmed date and latest sheet after you’ve heard from Ira and checked with Vik.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, I’m glad we could connect—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’d love your thoughts on what repairs we should prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa—Sunday at the community center helps. I’d prioritize essential fixes like bikes, lamps, and small appliances, but I’m still waiting on the confirmed repair list and volunteer gaps before steering people too specifically.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds right, Faye—let’s keep the focus on bikes, lamps, and small appliances for now, and I’ll share the confirmed repair list and volunteer gaps as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Vik, I’m helping with setup Saturday morning and planning to bring some basic tools, but I’m still double-checking the repair list before I repeat anything wrong.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah — I’ve been telling folks the repair drive is today and Cleo’s keeping the latest list, so check with her before you repeat details; tools, tape, spare parts, snacks, and handy volunteers all sound useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—today, not Saturday morning? Thanks, Vik, I’ll check with Cleo for the current list before I tell anyone else, and I’ll grab my tools if I can find that note.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Leo, I’m a bit fuzzy on the confirmed date, so I’d check with Vik or Ira—but last I heard they need small appliance and bike fixers, parts-sorting help, coffee help, and tools this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s today, this afternoon. Cleo has the list—bring any tools, tape, spare parts, snacks, or coffee help you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks, Leo—today this afternoon, got it. I’ll bring my spare screwdrivers and socket set, and I’ll tell folks Cleo has the proper list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nell, here’s what I’ve got so far: the repair drive is Saturday morning, Gus is bringing drills, clamps, and a workbench, and I’m checking who’s covering small appliances, sewing, and bike tune-ups before we spread the full list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules—that helps a lot. I’ll hold off on repeating anything too confidently until you hear back on appliances, sewing, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Nell—once I hear back from Sam, Priya, and Marco, I’ll send you one clean update you can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive so nobody misses it—would you like the details, or know anyone with tools or something that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn—I’d like to check Mina’s sheet first so we’re not guessing. Once I see the gaps, I’ll let you and Sam know what tools or helpers we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds perfect, Eli—check Mina’s sheet first, and once you spot the gaps I’ll help spread the word to fill them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, I’m still piecing together the repair drive while I’m out—Quinn’s doing outreach and Cleo’s got supplies, but do you know who has the actual repair signup list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the actual signup list yet, Ira—I’ve only got notes on categories and outreach. Can you check with Dane or Eli, and I’ll hold off confirming appliance or bike coverage until we see the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Hana—I’ll check back with Dane or Eli for the actual list, and I won’t repeat anything firm about appliances or bikes until it’s verified.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Noah, plan is still Saturday morning collection, but I’m waiting on Pia to confirm exact repair types. If you come early, I’ll put you on setup and small tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Leo—I’ll come early Saturday with small tools and hold off on sharing details until Pia confirms the repair types.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks. I’ll text you the confirmed repair list as soon as Pia answers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Quinn, I’m planning to bring drills, clamps, the spare workbench, screwdrivers, pliers, and a patch kit for the repair drive—anything else you think we’ll be short on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s a fantastic haul, Gus—thank you! If you can, bring extra extension cords or power strips too, since those always disappear fast at repair days.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Quinn—I’ll bring a couple extension cords and power strips along with the tools. I’ll label them so they don’t wander off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam, if you’re still available, could you start by noting the exact spots for the tool tables and supply boxes as they arrive? I’ll keep the main map updated from your notes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll track each tool table and supply box as it lands and send you clear notes for the main map.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Sam—please include landmarks like doorways or tent corners with each note, and flag anything that gets moved so I can update the map right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, I’m still piecing it together while I’m out—Quinn’s doing outreach and Cleo’s tracking supplies, but I’m trying to confirm who actually has the repair signup list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira—if you find out who has the actual sign-up list, can you loop me in? I’m waiting on confirmed details before I nudge anyone, especially with school pickup and drop-off to work around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Faye—I’ll loop you in as soon as I confirm who has the repair signup list, and I’ll keep pickup and drop-off timing in mind before nudging anyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Vik, thanks for spreading the word—can you confirm exactly what details you’re sharing, especially since bike tune-ups are confirmed but small appliances may still need checking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks the repair drive is today, Cleo has the official list, and useful supplies like tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks are welcome; I’ll say bike tune-ups are confirmed, but small appliances should be checked with Cleo first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—that wording sounds careful. Please keep pointing people to Cleo for the official list, and I’ll hold off on promising small appliance repairs until she confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli, I only know the rough bits: they’re looking for small-appliance and bike repair help, parts-sorting, coffee help, and tool donations today. I’d check with Vik or Ira for the confirmed date before you pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren—that’s helpful. I’ll keep it to the needs for now and check with Vik or Ira before I tell anyone a date.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds safest, Uli—sorry I’m fuzzy on the date, but I’d hate to send folks to the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep those categories and supplies marked tentative for now, and I won’t list anything as covered until we hear who has the confirmed signup list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Cleo—I'll treat everything as tentative for now and send Tess your way for the confirmed time, drop-off spot, and official signup list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — I’ll wait for Tess before updating anything as confirmed, and I’ll keep the supply notes clearly marked tentative for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Jules, I’m glad we could connect—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’d love to hear what repairs you think we should prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for the update, Rosa—I’ll help spread that it’s Sunday at the community center. I’d prioritize small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups since those are the lanes people are already circling around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s really helpful, Jules—let’s list small appliances, clothing mends, and basic bike tune-ups as our first lanes, and if you can spread the Sunday community center update, I’ll keep lining up volunteers for each table.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Mina—let’s sort the sheet by repair type first, then we’ll mark who’s signed up and what still has no volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, sort it that way, and put a blank column for missing parts or tools too. Once Ira brings Cleo’s list, we’ll fill the gaps instead of chasing guesses.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Agreed, Mina—I’ll add that blank parts-and-tools column now, and when Ira brings Cleo’s list we’ll compare it line by line.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m still waiting on confirmed details, so I’m checking with a few folks before we ask anyone to commit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo—please don’t ask anyone to commit until we have the actual date and repair list confirmed. Let me know who verifies it and where the signup list is coming from.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I won’t ask anyone to commit yet—I’ll just confirm the date, repair list, who verified it, and where the signup list is coming from, then circle back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I’m still piecing this together second-hand, but I’ve heard Vik and Cleo may be good coordination points for the repair drive—do you know if they’re handling signups?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t confirmed that, Nell, so I’d rather not send folks to Vik or Cleo yet. I’ll check with Rosa or Oren directly and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey—I’ll hold off on pointing anyone their way until you hear back from Rosa or Oren.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only heard the repair drive is still coming together, Bo—Quinn seems to have the firmest details. I can help a little, quietly, once the time and needs are settled.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks Uli—I’ll check with Quinn before I tell anyone anything. If you’re free once it’s settled, I’ll keep you in mind for a quiet helper slot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. A quiet helper slot would suit me, just let me know after Quinn confirms things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, I promised I’d ask Quinn and Opal today for the repair list, sign-up sheet, and uncovered stations, and I’ll get those to you as soon as they send them over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—when today should I expect them, and if Quinn or Opal don’t answer, who’s your backup?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check in with Quinn and Opal by noon and update you by 1; if they don’t answer, I’ll ask Rosa for the latest station notes and start a temporary sign-up sheet myself.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Quinn, I’m still getting the confirmed details together, but I heard Cleo has the supply list and the drive is today. Do you know which block you’re helping with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m covering the quick invites, but I won’t name a block until you confirm it—if Cleo has the supply list, I can nudge folks to check what they can bring today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—please nudge folks to bring tools, tape, spare parts, or snacks if they can, and I’ll confirm the block with Opal before we point anyone anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Nell, I’ve got the drills, clamps, spare workbench, hand tools, patch kit, and extra bits lined up, and I’m still checking on bike cables and small-appliance parts before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful, Gus—thank you. Since I’m still working from second-hand updates, I’d check in with Vik or Cleo before adding anything else to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good idea, Nell—I’ll check with Vik or Cleo before I haul over anything extra, and I’ll keep the basics ready either way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, I’m keeping to the verified list before we promise anything: Mina likely has the current sign-ups, and Rosa is gathering the Sunday repair priorities at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Eli — I’ll tell folks to check with Mina for current sign-ups and Rosa for Sunday priorities, and I’ll still point supply-list questions back to Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good clear plan, Vik—thank you. Once Mina and Rosa confirm their lists, I’ll help match helpers and tools without guessing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Cleo, we can now note the community room side door for small appliances and bikes by Friday evening, since Leo confirmed that; I’d still keep tools and spare parts marked “to verify” until the tool person is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll mark the community room side door as the drop-off spot for small appliances and bikes by Friday evening, and keep tools and spare parts as “to verify” until the tool person is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, Cleo—please also keep snacks listed as nice-to-have, and don’t announce any tool details until we have the tool person confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Dane, the repair drive is today; Cleo’s keeping the list, so bring tools, tape, spare parts, or snacks if you can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo—I’m late as usual but I’ll grab my basic tools and some tape, then check in with Cleo when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Dane—Cleo can point you where you’re needed when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Sam, yes—I’m still in for setup Saturday morning, and I’ll bring the tools I promised if I can keep them all in one pile by the door.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Noah—I’ll mark you down for setup and screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench set, and the extension cord if it makes it out the door. Even just the setup help is a big win.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Sam—I’ll set the tools by the door Friday night and aim to be there early Saturday for setup, unless my brain tries to wander off again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Jules—I’ll mark the handy folks, your block group, and the garden crew as tentative overlap points, then note appliances, clothing, and bike stations separately until we confirm who’s covering each spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Opal—once you’ve got that overlap map sketched, I’ll use it to reach out without duplicating folks, and I’ll confirm the appliance, sewing, and bike leads as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Jules—I’ll keep the overlap map marked tentative and add a checkoff column for appliance, sewing, and bike leads as you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, thanks—before I tell anyone anything, can you confirm who actually has the signup list and whether Saturday morning is truly the repair drive time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll hold off on spreading anything and confirm both who has the signup list and whether Saturday morning is final before I report back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira—please let me know once you’ve confirmed it directly, because I don’t want to pass along guesses about the signup list or Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Faye, I’m trying to get the repair drive details straight before I start spreading the word—have you heard the confirmed time or drop-off spot from Cleo yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Tess—I’m still waiting for a confirmed time, drop-off spot, and repair needs before I ask anyone to share it around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye—I'll hold off on spreading anything until Cleo confirms the time, drop-off spot, and what repairs they need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, thanks for being careful with that—so for now we should treat appliances and bicycles as listed but not yet staffed, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, Hana, that’s right—small appliances and bicycles are on the list, but I don’t have confirmed people covering them yet. I’d treat sorting parts and coffee as needs too, but hold announcements until we double-check names.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense—I'll hold off on announcing lane leads and mark appliances, bicycles, parts sorting, and coffee as needs until we confirm who’s covering each.
